rule: add-bank-coverage B8: each confirmation batch (sha256(NCT ID) mod 10 equal to 0, 1, 2) confirms one
version of the code, named by the source digest of TrialLedger/ and tests/ and its commit.
`trialledger sample --confirmation-batch N` reads only this file, refuses a batch given here to other
code, records the batch it drew for, and commits this file alone.
